source.status: Codex rules retained for 11th edition with Faction Pack v1.0 updates applied

detachments.title: Cohort Cybernetica
detachments.tagline: Legio Cybernetica engines advance under updated battle-programming.

rule.title: Cyber-psalm Programming
rule.text: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in LEGIO CYBERNETICA units from your army. In addition, unless that unit is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.title: Necromechanic
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw for a friendly LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE model within 12" fails, change that attack's Damage characteristic to 0.

enhancements.title: Lord of Machines
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Disrupt a visible enemy VEHICLE within 12" at the start of its Shooting phase, degrading or preventing its shooting according to its Leadership test.

enhancements.title: Emotionless Clarity
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Once per turn, a nearby friendly LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE with Deadly Demise automatically inflicts its Deadly Demise mortal wounds when destroyed.

enhancements.title: Arch-negator
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.title: Motive Imperative
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, add 3" to Move and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls for the unit.

stratagems.title: Auto-divinatory Targeting
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit and one objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, its ranged weapons have BS 3+ and [IGNORES COVER], but can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.

stratagems.title: Benevolence of the Omnissiah
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, models have Feel No Pain 6+, improved to 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.title: Machine Spirit Resurgent
stratagems.target: One eligible unit below Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll Hit rolls until your next Command phase; if Below Half-strength, re-roll Wound rolls as well.

stratagems.title: Machine Superiority
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: The unit can shoot after Falling Back and ignore modifiers to its characteristics, rolls and tests, excluding saving throws, until end of turn.

stratagems.title: Transcendent Cogitation
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Both Protector and Conqueror Imperatives are active for the unit until your next Command phase.

detachments.title: Data-psalm Conclave
detachments.tagline: Cult Mechanicus congregations chant a battle-long Benediction.

rule.title: Benedictions of the Omnissiah
rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one Benediction for CULT MECHANICUS units until the end of the battle. Panegyric Procession improves AP by 1 for ranged attacks within half range. Citation in Savagery adds 1 to Strength and Attacks of melee weapons when the unit fights after making a Charge move.

enhancements.title: Mechanicus Locum
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. The bearer has Leadership 6+ and can remove Battle-shock from one friendly CULT MECHANICUS unit within 12" once per battle.

enhancements.title: Mantle of the Gnosticarch
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change that attack's Damage characteristic to 1.

enhancements.title: Data-blessed Autosermon
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Once per battle, the bearer's unit can gain the other Benediction of the Omnissiah for the phase.

enhancements.title: Temporcopia
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. The bearer's unit has Fights First.

stratagems.title: Incantation of the Iron Soul
stratagems.when: Any phase, after allocating a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That CULT MECHANICUS model's unit.
stratagems.effect: CULT MECHANICUS models have Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds for the phase.

stratagems.title: Tribute of Empathic Veneration
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit and one enemy unit within 18".
stratagems.effect: The enemy takes a Battle-shock test; on failure, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls until your next Command phase.

stratagems.title: Litany of the Electromancer
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll for each nearby enemy unit; on a 5+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds, with +1 to the roll for ELECTRO-PRIESTS.

stratagems.title: Luminescent Blessing
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: CULT MECHANICUS models in the unit have a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

stratagems.title: Chant of the Remorseless Fist
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit that has not fought.
stratagems.effect: Add 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks made by CULT MECHANICUS models in the unit.

stratagems.title: Verse of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

detachments.title: Explorator Maniple
detachments.tagline: The Quest for Knowledge focuses the army around a chosen objective.

rule.title: Acquisition At Any Cost
rule.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker as your Acquisition objective marker until your next Command phase. Each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model attacks, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 if its unit or the target is within range of that marker.

enhancements.title: Artisan
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. While leading a unit within range of the Acquisition objective, once per phase change one Hit, Wound or saving throw result for that unit to an unmodified 6.

enhancements.title: Magos
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is within range of the Acquisition objective, gain 1CP on a 4+.

enhancements.title: Logis
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. While leading a unit, add 1 to Hit rolls against units within range of the Acquisition objective.

enhancements.title: Genetor
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. While leading a unit within range of the Acquisition objective, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.title: Cached Acquisition
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a unit is destroyed on a controlled objective.
stratagems.target: That destroyed ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: The objective remains under your control until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

stratagems.title: Infoslave Skull
stratagems.target: One TECH-PRIEST and another objective within 24".
stratagems.effect: The selected objective is also an Acquisition objective until your next Command phase.

stratagems.title: Priority Reclamation
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: It can Consolidate up to 6" if the move ends within range of the Acquisition objective.

stratagems.title: Auto-oracular Retrieval
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: Incense Exhausts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.title: Reactive Safeguard
stratagems.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after a charge is declared.
stratagems.target: One eligible ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit and a friendly TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: The unit can embark within that TRANSPORT if capacity and distance restrictions are met.

detachments.title: Rad-zone Corps
detachments.tagline: The battlefield is saturated with lethal radiation before the assault.

rule.title: Rad-bombardment
rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent chooses whether it takes cover or stands firm. Roll one D6 for each: a unit standing firm suffers D3 mortal wounds on a 3+; a unit taking cover is Battle-shocked and suffers D3 mortal wounds on a 5+. At the start of your Command phase in battle rounds 2-5, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone; on a 3+, it suffers 1 mortal wound and must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.title: Autoclavic Denunciation
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+].

enhancements.title: Malphonic Susurrus
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. While the bearer leads a unit, models in that unit have Stealth.

enhancements.title: Peerless Eradicator
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. While the bearer leads a unit, its ranged weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.title: Radial Suffusion
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Extends the reach of the Rad-bombardment fallout beyond the enemy deployment zone as described by the Enhancement.

stratagems.title: Extinction Order
stratagems.target: One TECH-PRIEST and one objective within 24".
stratagems.effect: Roll for enemy units on that objective; on a 4+ they suffer 1 mortal wound and take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.title: Lethal Dosage
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit that has not shot.
stratagems.effect: Its ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] for the phase.

stratagems.title: Pre-calibrated Purge Solution
stratagems.target: One eligible ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit, with a BATTLELINE relay option.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll Hit rolls for ranged attacks targeting units within the opponent's deployment zone.

stratagems.title: Aggressor Imperative
stratagems.target: One eligible SKITARII unit, with a BATTLELINE relay option.
stratagems.effect: When the targeted units Advance, add 6" to Move instead of rolling.

stratagems.title: Bulwark Imperative
stratagems.target: One targeted SKITARII unit, with a BATTLELINE relay option.
stratagems.effect: Models in the targeted units have a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

stratagems.title: Baleful Halo
stratagems.when: Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets.
stratagems.target: One non-VEHICLE ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit, with a BATTLELINE relay option.
stratagems.effect: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks targeting the selected units until end of turn.

detachments.title: Skitarii Hunter Cohort
detachments.tagline: Stealth-screened Skitarii hunt designated prey through sensor shadow.

rule.title: Stealth Optimisation
rule.text: SKITARII INFANTRY, SKITARII MOUNTED and IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units from your army have Stealth. Each time a ranged attack targets a SICARIAN unit from your army, unless the attacking model is within 12", the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.title: Veiled Hunter
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. After both players deploy, redeploy up to three SKITARII INFANTRY units; any can enter Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal limit. This is the Faction Pack v1.0 replacement.

enhancements.title: Clandestine Infiltrator
enhancements.text: SKITARII model only. The bearer and models in its led unit have Infiltrators and Scouts 6".

enhancements.title: Cantic Thrallnet
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. At the start of the battle round, select a friendly SKITARII unit within 12"; both Imperatives are active for it until the next battle round.

enhancements.title: Battle-sphere Uplink
enhancements.text: SKITARII model only. After the bearer's unit shoots, it can make the rule's reactive Normal move, subject to its restrictions.

stratagems.title: Binharic Offence
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two SKITARII units and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Improve AP by 1 for both units, but they can only target the selected enemy unit for the phase.

stratagems.title: Shroud Protocols
stratagems.target: One targeted SKITARII INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18" for the phase.

stratagems.title: Isolate and Destroy
stratagems.target: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN, IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6" of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: Expedited Purge Protocol
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit.
stratagems.effect: The unit can declare a charge after Advancing.

stratagems.title: Programmed Withdrawal
stratagems.target: Up to two SICARIAN units, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Remove eligible unengaged units and place them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.title: Bionic Endurance
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets.
stratagems.target: One targeted SICARIAN, PTERAXII or SYDONIAN unit.
stratagems.effect: Models in the unit have Feel No Pain 5+ for the phase.
